summary.text: Chris Turner is a State Representative in the Texas House, serving Tarrant County, including parts of Arlington and Grand Prairie. His official biography says he has served six terms and chairs the House Committee on Business & Industry.

paragraphs.text: Turner grew up in Dallas, has lived in Tarrant County for more than 20 years, and graduated from the University of Texas at Austin.
He works as a communications consultant when not in the Legislature.
He served as Chair of the House Democratic Caucus from 2017 to 2022, and chaired the House Committee on Higher Education during the 86th Legislature.
He lives in Grand Prairie with his wife, Lisa.
